historicalSource.note: Historical SPT 4.1.3 condition proofs remain research evidence and must not be treated as exact SPT 4.1.5 runtime authority.

acts.intent: Prove that the player can be trusted with reconnaissance, field support, low-profile movement, protection decisions and restricted access.
Turn early capability into concrete network protection against immediate Scav and PMC interference.
Use specialist precision, heavy protection and deliberate Rogue disruption against threats that can control routes and operational space.
Reserve late-game work for operations that prove independent judgement under severe pressure.

operations.playerProblem: A patrol heard movement along an Admiral route but could not classify the threat. The player verifies the approach without being ordered to manufacture a firefight.
mechanicIntent: active headset from final explicit allowlist
operations.distinctiveDecision: Listen and verify before choosing violence.
operations.uniquenessBoundary: Must remain non-combat in its required objectives so it does not duplicate Acoustic Contact.
runtimeProofRequired: same-raid equipment-to-extraction coupling if promised by final objective

operations.playerProblem: A forward element lost its ordinary maintenance reserve and needs one replacement package to keep the route operational.
operations.distinctiveDecision: Solve one concrete logistics shortage rather than service an endless trader shopping list.
operations.uniquenessBoundary: No second maintenance-package quest unless the logistical problem and required player behavior are materially different.
runtimeProofRequired: final TPL availability and Economy Admiral acquisition-burden recheck

operations.playerProblem: Admiral needs proof that the player can move useful cargo without advertising expensive PMC equipment to everyone on the route.
operations.distinctiveDecision: Choose inconspicuous, replaceable equipment because visibility itself is the operational cost.
operations.uniquenessBoundary: The low-tier pair is narrative identity, not the first step of a rig/backpack ladder.
runtimeProofRequired: SPT 4.1.5 Equipment semantics for two simultaneous explicit equipment requirements

operations.playerProblem: The player must prove that light protection supports movement through a threatened route instead of becoming the purpose of the raid.
operations.distinctiveDecision: Accept limited protection in exchange for mobility and finish the route instead of extending the fight.
operations.uniquenessBoundary: No armor-class staircase. Helmet qualification is not a separate early quest.

operations.playerProblem: Admiral needs one restricted route confirmed as usable; key ownership itself is irrelevant.
mechanicIntent: one final restricted-route VisitPlace or equally truthful native proxy
operations.distinctiveDecision: Use access to solve a route problem rather than collect keys.
operations.uniquenessBoundary: No key catalogue, no per-map access copies and no promise that runtime detected personal key use unless SPT 4.1.5 proves it.

operations.playerProblem: A previously observed route now has an immediate hostile presence; the player must use situational awareness to choose and finish a short contact.
mechanicIntent: active headset from final explicit allowlist
Woods or final justified route location
operations.distinctiveDecision: Apply acoustic preparation to one deliberate engagement after reconnaissance has already established the route context.
operations.uniquenessBoundary: Must remain a combat application and must not become another headset ownership quest.

operations.playerProblem: Local Scav groups are turning a practical Customs supply corridor into an ambush line and movement must be restored.
operations.distinctiveDecision: Break the immediate threat only long enough to restore movement, then leave.
operations.uniquenessBoundary: No same objective on every map and no escalating clearance sequels.
runtimeProofRequired: SPT 4.1.5 ordinary Scav role and bigmap target

operations.playerProblem: A hostile PMC element is exploiting a Reserve movement window that matters to Admiral's network.
operations.distinctiveDecision: Deny a specific hostile window rather than conduct population-control PMC farming.
operations.uniquenessBoundary: No faction ladder, no per-map PMC copies and no dogtag conveyor.

operations.playerProblem: A threatened route needs one controlled long-range observation and denial action before the position becomes predictable.
operations.distinctiveDecision: Use distance to control one problem and disengage; distance is not a score in itself.
operations.uniquenessBoundary: Absorbs the old Precision Denial purpose. No second distance-threshold quest unless a new player decision exists.
operations.rewardChangeRationale: Raised modestly from the historical Observation Window allocation because the final operation absorbs the only useful specialist purpose from Precision Denial; no removed reward budget is automatically redistributed.
runtimeProofRequired: SPT 4.1.5 distance unit and comparator semantics

operations.playerProblem: A prepared position requires the player to accept the mobility cost of heavy protection for one deliberate assault and still disengage alive.
mechanicIntent: ballistic head protection included where mechanically justified
operations.distinctiveDecision: Use heavy protection for the moment it changes the assault outcome, then leave before weight dictates the operation.
operations.uniquenessBoundary: Absorbs Ballistic Head Test. No separate helmet ladder or armor-class progression.

operations.playerProblem: The Lighthouse water-treatment perimeter is being used as a controlled fire lane and Admiral needs that pattern disrupted long enough to reopen movement.
operations.distinctiveDecision: Disrupt the defensive pattern and leave instead of farming towers after the route problem is solved.
operations.uniquenessBoundary: No escalating Rogue kill sequence and no Rogue-equipment storefront created as the payoff.

operations.playerProblem: The player already has Labs access; now Admiral needs proof that the clearance can be used under pressure without turning the raid into Raider farming.
operations.distinctiveDecision: Use existing access, disrupt one security response and recognize when the operation is complete.
operations.uniquenessBoundary: No keycard faucet, Raider-equipment storefront, access bypass or escalating Raider counters.

mergedOrHeld.reason: Standalone wear-helmet/contact/extract play is too similar to the light/heavy protection chain and recreates a miniature Iron Head ladder.
The historical concept did not introduce a sufficiently different decision from Observation Window; useful advanced precision identity is retained in one stronger operation.
Survive once on three maps is still fundamentally an extraction checklist. It returns only if a distinct late-game operational problem can be expressed with native SPT 4.1.5 mechanics.

rewardSummary.policy: Thematic one-time samples may be introduced later only after Economy Admiral review and must replace part of cash value rather than stack above the approved envelope.
